title: Referrals and Authorizations Training Note: Emergency Visit Frequency and Days Approved
content:
Questions answered for representatives on **Referrals and Authorizations**: how emergency frequency bears on the days approved when a TRICARE Prime request is approved to the network provider after the military clinic's response window has passed.

**What adds days on this ground?** Emergency frequency adds days. Where three or more emergency department visits of the patient are dated in the last month, two days are added; where exactly two are, one day is added; otherwise none.

**Which visits are counted?** The emergency department visits of the patient on the patient's TRICARE Prime claim lines dated in the last month.

**What if the patient has exactly one emergency visit in the last month?** No day is added on this ground, and none is added where there is no such visit.

**What if there are five?** Five is three or more, so two days are added, the same as for three.

| Emergency department visits dated in the last month | Days added |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2 |
| exactly 2 | 1 |
| 1 or none | 0 |
